dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who's in charge of these things, usually?

dialogues.speaker: Wernher
dialogues.text: Great question! As disciplinary officer of the Garrison Squad, I keep an eye on the day-to-day behavior of the knights.

dialogues.speaker: Wernher
dialogues.text: From their conduct while in uniform to how they carry themselves among civilians on their days off... There are over 200 rules that every knight has to abide by.

dialogues.speaker: Wernher
dialogues.text: The first code of conduct wasn't that detailed, to be honest. We were fairly relaxed at the beginning.

dialogues.speaker: Wernher
dialogues.text: But exchanges with the Millelith gave us many insights into about disciplinary structures. That gave us the idea to thoroughly expand our code of conduct...

dialogues.speaker: Wernher
dialogues.text: Strict adherence to military discipline can make the squad more effective in combat!
